candidate.title: PD-Seq
candidate.scope: Assigned Illumina PD-Seq schematic, interpreted at schematic level as the apigenin/PEGA-bead phage-display screen described by the supplied catalogue. The drawing contains bead preparation and an RNA-to-phage-display branch converging on repeated binding/washing and PCR of selected phage inserts to DNA. Its leftmost Protein target motif and PD-Seq identifies candidate cellular targets for proteins caption are an explanatory overview, with no material-transfer arrow into the bead branch. Only PD-Seq is a target workflow; the associated kit is not another method. The supplied primary paper evidence is abstract-only; it supports the apigenin/phage-display/sequencing association, not detailed coupling chemistry. Sequencing is a catalogue-supported readout interface beyond the drawn DNA endpoint.
